title: Content of a lernapps explainer, format 2
description: Format 2 of the content of an app built from the archetype explainer (runtime @lernapps/app-templates), as YAML in src/: the app (src/app.yaml), each chapter (src/<chapter>/chapter.yaml), each page (src/<chapter>/<page>.yaml) and data files (src/data/<name>.yaml). Format 2 places the app on the learning map of the catalog: src/app.yaml says format: 2 and names the app's strand (or none), and every page names the competencies it practises, or, as a recap page, a competency it repeats that the app does not practise. Everything else is as in format 1 (explainer.v1.schema.json), whose parts this schema refers to; an app.yaml without format is format 1. The build validates every file against this schema, then what a schema cannot say (among it: competencies or recap on every page when the app has a strand, no competencies when its strand is none, no exercise on a recap page), and writes lernapps-pages.json, the list of the app's pages for the catalog.

strand.description: The strand (Strang) of the learning map the app stays in: <subject>/<strand>, the ids of a subject of the catalog and of one of its strands, e.g. mathematik/stochastik; or none, when the app is on no strand (then it is not on the map). One app, one strand.

competency.description: A competency the app does not practise itself, which a recap page repeats: <subject>/<competency>, the ids of a subject of the catalog and of one of its competencies, e.g. physik/gewichtskraft-berechnen.

app.description: src/app.yaml in format 2: format: 2, the app's strand, then everything as in format 1: its title, intro, languages and the order of its chapters.

format.description: The format of the content: 2. Required in format 2; an app.yaml without it is format 1 (explainer.v1.schema.json), which has no strand and no competencies.

page.description: src/<chapter>/<page>.yaml in format 2: a page as in format 1, and the competencies it practises; or a recap page, which repeats a competency the app does not practise (recap) instead of practising competencies of its own.

competencies.description: The competencies (Bausteine) of the learning map that the page practises: ids of the subject of the app's strand, at least one, each once; as a rule one. Required on every page but a recap page when src/app.yaml names a strand; not allowed when its strand is none, and not on a recap page. The app cannot know the subject's ids; the catalog checks them when the app is listed.

recap.description: Makes the page a recap page: it repeats a competency the app does not practise itself (of another strand, or of its own strand outside its scope) that a competency of the app requires, <subject>/<competency>, e.g. physik/gewichtskraft-berechnen. The app does not practise it: a recap page has descriptive blocks only, no exercise (no question type, no generated, no open-task, no exercise component), and needs none. Instead of competencies, never with them; allowed with strand: none too. The page shows at its top that it is a recap, with a link to the competency's page on the learning map of lernapps.net, where the apps are that practise it; the navigation marks it, the self-assessment leaves it out, and lernapps-pages.json names it with recap instead of competencies. It counts as nothing on the map.
